page.layout: One text column on the left, with items 1 to 3 at its head and the running text below. Margin notes stand in the right margin beside the text. Running head at the top, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: 1. οὐσίαν[?] seu essentiam corporalem, quâ est. Hanc comitatur corporis existentia.
2. Δύναμιν seu potentiam ac facultatem, qua naturaliter tum habile, tum efficax est. Hæc igitur & habilitatem naturalem, & operosam efficaciam includit.
3. ἐνέργειαν[?] seu actionem, quæ procedit ab essentia per potentiam.

Omne itaq; corpus naturale est ex materia sua, à quâ quantitas corporis, per formam suam, à qua quantitas terminata, seu termini quantitatis. Idem habile & efficax est, per naturam sibi inditam, & suis qualitatibus instructam.Corpus naturale ex quibus constet.
Idem vero operatur & efficit, aut per emanationem, aut per transmutationem.Eius operatio.
Emanatio hic est, interior effecti seu motus à virtute corporis naturali consecutio & productio.
Transmutatio hic est exterior agentis & moventis naturalis transitio in subjectum patiens.
Hinc Actio corporis naturalis est Immanens vel transiens.

page.notes: The Greek words in items 1 and 3 are uncertain at the first letters and are marked [?]. The page number at the top right is read as "3" and is uncertain. Faint marks in the right margin lower down (near the middle and lower part) are too faint to read and look like show-through from the other side, so they are omitted. The printed hyphen at the end of "na-" is kept, and the catchword "turali" is taken from the foot of the page.
